title: Export
$comment: v1.0. An MP4 export of a workflow's tutorial (Phase 5; decisions D6 and D13-D20 in docs/research/phase-5-decisions-alignment.md).
description: One MP4 render of one workflow version with one preset. Created by POST /workflows/{id}/exports, rendered by the export job, polled with GET /exports/{id}.

revision.description: The workflow version that was exported (Workflow.revision at the time of the request).

title.description: The workflow's title, for the dialog and the file name.

progress.description: Render progress in percent. 0 while queued, 100 when ready.

download_url.description: API path of the MP4 (GET /exports/{id}/download) when ready, else null.

captions_url.description: API path of the WebVTT captions (GET /exports/{id}/captions.vtt) when ready and captions exist, else null.

error.description: Why the export failed. Null unless status is failed.

finished_at.description: When the export became ready or failed.

ExportPreset.title: ExportPreset
ExportPreset.description: landscape = 1920x1080 (16:9), portrait = 1080x1920 (9:16, follows the highlight). Both 30 fps, H.264 + AAC.

ExportStatus.title: ExportStatus
ExportStatus.description: queued -> rendering -> ready | failed; ready -> expired when cleanup deletes the file (the row stays).

message.description: Short, safe to show to the user. Never contains secrets.
